title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Microsoft Azure
providers.scope_notes: Covers Microsoft Azure (Azure Storage, Azure Resource Manager, Microsoft Entra Workload ID, Azure DevOps Services). Azure Storage and ARM controls are per subscription/account; Conditional Access for workload identities needs Workload Identities Premium; Azure DevOps PAT policies need an Entra-backed organization. Entra delegated/app-only OAuth for Graph and managed identities are covered by the separate microsoft platform.

controls.name: Allow storage account key access (AllowSharedKeyAccess = false)
controls.what: Rejects all requests authorized with account keys, including account and service SAS; user delegation SAS still works.
controls.setting: Storage account > Configuration > Allow storage account key access; ARM property allowSharedKeyAccess

controls.name: Azure Policy: Storage accounts should prevent shared key access
controls.what: Audits or prevents storage accounts that permit Shared Key authorization.

controls.name: Regenerate key (RegenerateKey)
controls.what: Replaces an account key and revokes SAS signed with that key.
controls.setting: Storage account > Access keys > Rotate key; POST .../regenerateKey

controls.name: Key expiration policy
controls.what: Shows a reminder and enables Azure Policy compliance checks when keys are not rotated in the interval; does not disable keys.
controls.setting: Storage account > Security + networking > Access keys > Set rotation reminder

controls.name: Storage firewall network rules
controls.what: Limits which IPs, VNets and resource instances can reach the account endpoint.

no_control.what: Key expiration policy only reminds; keys never expire.

controls_unknown: Whether Azure Activity Log records the service principal identity for ARM read calls made with azure-3/azure-4 tokens (Activity log typically skips reads).
Exact Entra audit activity name for adding/removing a federated identity credential.
Default of the Azure DevOps "IP Conditional Access policy validation on non-interactive flows" policy.
Maximum Azure DevOps PAT lifetime when no tenant policy is set.
Token format or prefix for storage keys, SAS, client secrets or Azure DevOps PATs.
Whether app management policies require a specific license.

authentication.summary: Two account keys (key1/key2) per storage account; requests are HMAC-SHA256 signed in the SharedKey Authorization header. Keys give full data access and can mint SAS tokens.

federation.details: Shared Key does not use Microsoft Entra ID, so Entra Conditional Access does not apply; docs say Shared Key must be disallowed to protect an account with Conditional Access.

ip_restriction.boundary: Storage firewall network rules (IP, VNet, resource instance, trusted services) apply to requests to the account endpoint; default allows any network.

lifetime.summary: No expiry; key expiration policy only shows a rotation reminder

renewal.summary: Keys stay valid until regenerated; rotate by switching to the second key, then regenerating the first.

administration.summary: Anyone with Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listkeys/action can read keys. Admins can disallow Shared Key per account (AllowSharedKeyAccess=false) and enforce that with Azure Policy.
administration.conditions: Shared Key is allowed when the property is unset.

sso.details: Docs say Conditional Access protects a storage account only after Shared Key authorization is disallowed.

offboard.details: The two access keys belong to the storage account, not to a user.

inventory.details: Each account has exactly two keys, listed under Security + networking > Access keys or with az storage account keys list (per account).

usage.ui: Storage account > Monitoring > Diagnostic settings: send StorageBlobLogs to a Log Analytics workspace; then Logs: StorageBlobLogs | where AuthenticationType == "AccountKey"; group by AuthenticationHash to tell keys apart

reads.ui: Log Analytics (after diagnostic setting): StorageBlobLogs | where AuthenticationType == "AccountKey" and OperationName == "GetBlob"

kill.ui: Storage account > Security + networking > Access keys > Regenerate (each key); or Settings > Configuration > Allow storage account key access = Disabled
kill.cli: az storage account keys renew --resource-group <rg> --account-name <account> --key primary (then --key secondary); or az storage account update --name <account> --resource-group <rg> --allow-shared-key-access false

log_sources.name: Azure Activity Log
log_sources.notes: Control-plane writes/actions (e.g. listKeys, regenerateKey); 90 days free; reads typically not captured.

log_sources.name: Azure Storage resource logs (StorageBlobLogs)
log_sources.notes: Data-plane requests incl. AuthenticationType and AuthenticationHash; not collected until a diagnostic setting routes them.

credential_id_fields.notes: key1|key2 plus SHA-256 hash of key.

containment.steps: Regenerate the exposed key (and the other if unsure); or set AllowSharedKeyAccess=false.
containment.notes: Regenerating also revokes SAS signed with that key; dependent apps break.

calls.log_notes: StorageBlobLogs only if diagnostic setting configured.

unknown: No whoami call for Shared Key or SAS.

detections.title: Azure Storage Account Shared Key Access Enabled
